name: the correction of a line that read its ops from stdin keeps --ops - and says to pipe the same document again, and passes a password from stdin on by its variable

json.equals: Did you mean 'cells edit'? Run 'aspose-cli cells edit plain.xlsx --ops - --out x.xlsx --output-format json', piping the same --ops document to it on stdin as this command read it.
Run 'aspose-cli cells edit plain.xlsx --ops - --out y.xlsx --output-format json', piping the same --ops document to it on stdin as this command read it.
Run 'aspose-cli cells edit plain.xlsx --ops - --out z.xlsx --password-env "<password-env>" --output-format json', piping the same --ops document to it on stdin as this command read it.
